scope: Synthetic animation reference using the actual Renderer.sprite, FlightWings and visualEmission. No combat simulation or engine scheduling claim.

video.captureMethod: 240 real wall-clock RAF-deadline canvas samples, saved losslessly and encoded at 60 Hz to retain every sampled frame; not a fixed simulation step or MediaRecorder frame-count claim.
video.encoding: Lossless VP9 with 4:4:4 chroma to avoid codec blur at native pixel edges.

emitterErrorAfterExplicitForwardOffset.note: Includes both rounding operations used to place the articulated image; the emitter retains its explicit 2-native-pixel forward offset.

sourceSnapshot: All listed source files were captured before browser launch and served from those exact bytes throughout this run.

review.approvalScope: Synthetic flight/targeting references only. Live combat scheduling, impacts, unit interactions and the remaining Pokemon require their separate review.
review.note: Some mobile one-native-pixel or smaller fragments appear at specific raster angles. The original opaque foreground is one connected component in all 24 rig views, with no detached retained-body residues. No source pixels or components were deleted.
